'''Carl Mike Hardy Hoth Light Side Training Deck''' is a [[Light]] training list published on [[Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site]]. [[Carl Mike Hardy]] built it from Common and Uncommon cards for teaching.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Carl Mike Hardy]]
* '''Published:''' by January 2001 (Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room)|Hoth-L-hothechocommandcenterwarroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hoth Light Side

== Introduction ==

The published list has 30 cards.
